pois.name: Monumento a Mihai
pois.intro: Mihai Eminescu was a Romanian Romantic poet, novelist, and journalist from Moldavia, generally regarded as the most famous and influential Romanian poet. Eminescu was an active member of the Junimea literary society and worked as an editor for the newspaper Timpul, the official newspaper of the Conservative Party.

pois.name: Alberto Korda (Fotógrafo)
pois.description: Fotógrafo. Alberto Díaz Gutiérrez (La Habana, 14 de septiembre de 1928-París, 25 de mayo de 2001), más conocido como Alberto Korda y  por la famosa fotografía tomada al Che Guevara .
pois.intro: Alberto Díaz Gutiérrez, better known as Alberto Korda or simply Korda, was a Cuban photographer, remembered for his famous image Guerrillero Heroico of Argentine Marxist revolutionary Che Guevara.

pois.name: Dr. Carlos J. Finlay
pois.intro: Carlos Juan Finlay was a Cuban epidemiologist recognized as a pioneer in the research of yellow fever, determining that it was transmitted through mosquitoes Aedes aegypti.

pois.name: Monumento a Nicolás Guillén
pois.intro: Nicolás Cristóbal Guillén Batista was a Cuban poet, journalist and political activist. He is best remembered as the national poet of Cuba.

pois.name: Parque Guayasamín
pois.intro: Oswaldo Guayasamín Calero was an Ecuadorian painter and sculptor of Kichwa and Mestizo heritage.

pois.name: Dulce María Loynaz
pois.intro: Dulce María Loynaz Muñoz was a Cuban poet, and is considered one of the principal figures of Cuban literature. She was awarded the Miguel de Cervantes Prize in 1992.

pois.name: Lezama Lima
pois.intro: José María Andrés Fernando Lezama Lima was a Cuban writer, poet and essayist. He is considered one of the most influential figures in Cuban and Latin American literature.

pois.name: Museo de la Revolución
pois.address: Calle Refugio e/ Zulueta y Monserrate, La Habana
pois.intro: The Museum of the Revolution is located in the Old Havana section of Havana, Cuba, in what was the presidential palace of all Cuban presidents from Mario García Menocal to Fulgencio Batista. The building became the Museum of the Revolution during the years following the Cuban Revolution.

pois.name: Rubén González
pois.intro: Rubén González Fontanills was a Cuban pianist. Together with Lilí Martínez and Peruchín he is said to have "forged the style of modern Cuban piano playing in the 1940s".

pois.name: Tomás Gutiérrez Alea (Titón)
pois.intro: Tomás Gutiérrez Alea was a Cuban film director and screenwriter. Gutiérrez Alea wrote and directed more than twenty features, documentaries, and short films, which are known for his sharp insight into post-Revolutionary Cuba, and possess a delicate balance between dedication to the revolution and criticism of the social, economic, and political conditions of the country.

pois.name: Castillo de la Real Fuerza
pois.wikipedia: es:Castillo de la Real Fuerza de La Habana
pois.intro: The Castillo de la Real Fuerza is a bastion fort on the western side of the harbour in Havana, Cuba, set back from the entrance, and bordering the Plaza de Armas. Originally built to defend Havana against attack by pirates, it was not strategically located, being too far inside the bay, and instead was adopted as the residence of the Governor of Havana.

pois.name: Federico Laredo Brú
pois.description: Presidente de la República de Cuba (1936-1940).
pois.intro: Federico Laredo Brú was an attorney and served as President of Cuba from 1936 to 1940. He was married to Leonor Gomez-Montes.

pois.name: Monumento a Julio Antonio Mella
pois.intro: Julio Antonio Mella McPartland was a Cuban political activist, journalist, communist revolutionary, and one of the founders of the original Communist Party of Cuba. Mella studied law at the University of Havana but was expelled in 1925.

pois.name: Rita Montaner
pois.intro: Rita Aurelia Fulcida Montaner y Facenda, known as Rita Montaner, was a Cuban singer, pianist and actress. In Cuban parlance, she was a vedette, and was well known in Mexico City, Paris, Miami and New York, where she performed, filmed and recorded on numerous occasions.

pois.name: Castillo de los Tres Reyes del Morro
pois.wikipedia: es:Castillo de los Tres Reyes Magos del Morro
pois.intro: The Castillo de los Tres Reyes del Morro, also known as Castillo del Morro, is a fortress guarding the entrance to the Havana harbor. The design is by the Italian engineer Battista Antonelli.

pois.name: Museo de la Ciudad
pois.address: Calle Tacón e/ O'Reilly y Obispo
pois.intro: The Palacio de los Capitanes Generales is the former official residence of the Spanish Empire's governors of Havana, Cuba, and in the Post-Colonial Period was for many time the City Hall. Located on the eastern side of the Plaza de Armas in Old Havana it is home to the Museum of the City of Havana.

pois.name: Museo Nacional de Bellas Artes
pois.intro: The National Museum of Fine Arts of Havana in Havana, Cuba, is a museum of fine arts that exhibits Cuban art collections from the colonial times up to contemporary generations.

pois.name: Hasekura Rokuemon Tsunenaga
pois.description: La estatua muestra a Hasekura Tsunenaga con su kimono ondeando suavemente y un abanico en la mano, transmitiendo dignidad y determinación.
pois.intro: Hasekura Rokuemon Tsunenaga was a kirishitan Japanese samurai and retainer of Date Masamune, the daimyō of Sendai. He was of Japanese imperial descent with ancestral ties to Emperor Kanmu.

pois.name: Museo Nacional de Historia Natural
pois.intro: The Museo Nacional de Historia Natural Cubana or Museo Nacional de Historia Natural de Cuba in Havana, Cuba is the national museum of Natural History, with exhibits of Cuba's plants and animals. It is located in a former U.S. embassy building.

pois.name: Museo Nacional de la Música
pois.address: Calle Capdevila e/ Habana y Aguiar
pois.description: En este centro se encuentra información referente a la vida musical de Benny Moré
pois.intro: El Museo Nacional de la Música es un museo centrado en la musicología en La Habana, Cuba. Trata el desarrollo de la música y los instrumentos en el país, desde el siglo XVI hasta el XX. Cuenta con una colección de instrumentos musicales cubanos e internacionales, así como numerosos documentos, partituras y otros bienes.

pois.name: Dr. Carlos J. Finlay Barres
pois.intro: Carlos Juan Finlay was a Cuban epidemiologist recognized as a pioneer in the research of yellow fever, determining that it was transmitted through mosquitoes Aedes aegypti.

pois.name: Castillo de San Salvador de la Punta
pois.intro: Castillo San Salvador de la Punta is a fortress at the entrance to the bay in Havana, Cuba.

pois.name: La Bodeguita del Medio
pois.intro: La Bodeguita del Medio is a restaurant-bar in Havana, Cuba. La Bodeguita lays claim to being the birthplace of the Mojito cocktail, prepared in the bar since its opening in 1942, although this is disputed.

pois.name: Floridita
pois.intro: Floridita or El Floridita is a historic fish restaurant and cocktail bar in the older part of Havana, Cuba. It lies at the end of Calle Obispo, across Monserrate Street from the National Museum of Fine Arts of Havana.

pois.name: Sloppy Joe's Bar
pois.intro: Sloppy Joe's Bar is a historic bar located in Havana, Cuba. The bar reopened in 2013 after being closed for 48 years.

pois.name: Coppelia
pois.intro: Coppelia is an ice cream parlor chain in Cuba, named after the ballet Coppélia. Originally built in a project led by Fidel Castro, Coppelia is state-run and sells in Cuban pesos.

pois.intro: John Lennon Park or Parque John Lennon is a public park, located in the Vedado district in Havana, Cuba.

pois.name: Parque Central
pois.address: Paseo de Martí (Paseo del Prado), Habana Vieja
pois.intro: The Parque Central, Havana is one of the best known and central sites of the city of Havana, Cuba. It is located between Prado, Neptuno, Zulueta and San José streets, and San Rafael Boulevard.

pois.name: Parque de la Fraternidad
pois.intro: The Parque de la Fraternidad was built in the 1790s as a military practice range by the Spanish government, It was expanded in 1793 by Belgian engineer Agustin Cramer, and later Bishop Espada improved the lighting of the Campo. It was Captain General Don Miguel Tacón who included it within the scope of his embellishment program.

pois.name: Casa y museo de José Martí
pois.intro: Дом-музей Хосе Марти — дом на окраине Гаваны, в котором 28 января 1853 года родился латиноамериканский поэт и журналист, национальный герой Кубы, лидер освобождения страны от Испании — Хосе Марти.

pois.name: Plaza de La Catedral
pois.intro: Plaza de la Catedral is one of the four main squares in Old Havana and the site of the Cathedral of Havana from which it takes its name. Originally a swamp, it was later drained and used as a naval dockyard.

pois.name: Museo Ernest Hemingway
pois.address: Calle Vigía y Steinhart. Finca Vigía, San Francisco de Paula, La Habana
pois.intro: Finca Vigía is a house in San Francisco de Paula ward in Havana, Cuba, which was once the residence of Ernest Hemingway. Like Hemingway's Key West home, it is now a museum.

pois.name: Museo Nacional de Artes Decorativas
pois.address: 502 Calle 17 esq. D, Vedado, Plaza de la Revolución, La Habana
pois.intro: The Museum of Decorative Arts, at 17th and E streets in the Vedado district of Havana, Cuba is a decorative arts museum in the former residence of the María Luisa Gómez-Mena viuda de Cagiga, Countess of Revilla de Camargo, sister of José Gómez-Mena Vila, the owner of the Manzana de Gómez. It was designed in Paris by architects P. Virad and M.

pois.name: Plaza Vieja
pois.intro: The Plaza Vieja is a plaza located in Old Havana, Cuba. The plaza and its surroundings are also one of the seven consejos populares of the municipality of Old Havana.

pois.name: Faro Castillo del Morro
pois.intro: Faro Castillo del Morro is a lighthouse located in Havana, Cuba. It was built in 1845 on the ramparts of the Castillo de los Tres Reyes Magos del Morro, an old fortress guarding the harbor of Havana.
